constellationsFaqA1: There are 88 officially recognised constellations, as defined by the International Astronomical Union in 1922.
constellationsFaqQ2: Which constellations are in the zodiac?
constellationsFaqA2: The zodiac constellations along the ecliptic are Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpius, Sagittarius, Capricornus, Aquarius and Pisces. Ophiuchus also crosses the ecliptic.
constellationsFaqA3: Hydra is the largest constellation by area, followed by Virgo and Ursa Major. Crux is the smallest.
